$description: Every component in @euvino/ds, generated from source. Figma names the matching library set.

Icon.description: Draws one icon from the system's Iconoir set. It takes the surrounding text colour. Import icons through this, never from an icon package.

name.description: Which icon to draw, in Iconoir naming: `trash`, `check`, `warning-triangle`, `close`.

label.description: Accessible name. Leave empty when the icon is decoration next to text; it is then hidden from screen readers.

className.description: Extra class on the svg. The colour comes from the surrounding text colour.

Stack.description: Lays out a row or column with a space token between children. Use it instead of hand-written flex and margins. It is the code form of auto layout in Figma.

direction.description: `vertical` for a column (default), `horizontal` for a row.

gap.description: Space token between children, from `spacing/*`: form fields `4`, button rows `2`, page sections `8`.

noValidate.description: With `as="form"`: turn off browser validation bubbles so field `error` messages show instead.

padding.description: Padding from the same space tokens.

justify.description: Main-axis distribution. `between` pushes children to both ends.

wrap.description: Wrap children onto new lines when they do not fit.

as.description: Which element to render, such as `section`, `form` or `ul`.

Text.description: Any text set in a library text style and colour token. Use it for headings, paragraphs and captions instead of raw font sizes.

variant.description: Text style from the library. `h1` to `h6` are Roboto Condensed Bold; everything else is Roboto. `caption-medium` is the field-label style (13 medium), for headings that sit among form fields.

tone.description: Colour token. Defaults to `primary` for headings and `body` for reading text.

as.description: Element to render when it should differ from the style's default, such as an `h2` styled as `h4`.

VisuallyHidden.description: Text for screen readers only, such as a table caption or a live status line.

children.description: Text only screen readers should announce.

Divider.description: Separates groups of content. Prefer spacing first; add a line only when spacing is not enough.

label.description: Optional centred label, such as "or".

LinkButton.description: A text link that navigates. Use Button when it runs an action.

variant.description: `primary` uses text/link, `secondary` uses text/body. `link` is an inline text link in foreground/link (emails, phone numbers): it keeps the surrounding text style. `plain` keeps the surrounding colour and style and underlines on hover, for names that open a record.

SegmentedControl.description: Switches the display of the same content in place, such as List and Grid. Not for page navigation (TopNav). Segments share the width equally, sized to the longest label.

value.description: The selected value. One segment is always selected.

label.description: Accessible name of the group, such as "View".

size.description: `medium` 46 high (default). `small` 34 high with caption text, for toolbars inside cards.

Chip.description: An interactive pill for filters and tags. Use Badge for something that only shows a status.

onRemove.description: When set, shows a remove button with this handler. Needs `removeLabel`.

removeLabel.description: Accessible name of the remove button, such as "Remove Germany".

PersonChip.description:
A person in a field or list, such as a participant: avatar (initials or picture), name and a remove button.
Not a filter: use Chip for filters and tags. Grey fill, no stroke; the avatar sits inset on the left.
PersonChip.example: <PersonChip name="Maximilian Eul" photo={url} onRemove={remove} removeLabel="Maximilian Eul entfernen" />

name.description: Person's name. Shown, and gives the avatar's initials.

photo.description: Picture URL. Without it the avatar shows initials.

suffix.description: Extra text after the name, such as "(Sie)".

onRemove.description: Shows the remove button. Leave out for someone who cannot be removed, such as the organiser.

removeLabel.description: Accessible name of the remove button, such as "Maximilian Eul entfernen".

onClick.description: Opens the person, such as their contact. Makes the name area a button.

Button.description: Runs an action. Start the label with a verb and name the result: "Create request", not "OK". Default type is `button`, so set `type="submit"` in forms.

variant.description:
Emphasis. `primary` = the main action of a view. `secondary` = a real alternative, and Cancel next to a primary action. `tertiary` = the least emphasis: text actions such as "Add phone number" or Import.
`primary-2` = deprecated: Hydra has no orange call to action, so it renders as `primary`. Use `primary`.
`danger` = the final irreversible action inside a confirmation. `danger-secondary` = the entry point that opens that confirmation.

icon.description: Which icon to show. Buttons are text-only by default; add an icon only when it adds meaning. Pick the side with `iconPosition`.

iconPosition.description: Which side of the label the `icon` goes on. Defaults to `left`.

loading.description: Shows a Loader, sets `aria-busy` and blocks clicks while keeping the label and width.

IconButton.description: A Button that shows only an icon (Content = Only Icons in Figma). The label is required because nothing else names it.

label.description: Required accessible name, such as "Remove file".

variant.description: Same emphasis as Button. Defaults to `tertiary`.

size.description: Square size, same scale as Button.

indicator.description: Small dot in the corner: something behind this button is on, such as an active filter or sort. Say so in `label` too.

Dropdown.description: Choose one value from a list. It opens below the field and supports the arrow keys. To run commands use Menu; for two to four visible choices use Radio or SegmentedControl.

label.description: Visible label.

hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for screen readers only, for repeated rows where a visible label already sits above.

placeholder.description: Text shown when nothing is selected.

Combobox.description: A field you can type into or pick from a scrolling list, such as a time or a duration. Text is read on Enter or when the field loses focus; unreadable text goes back to the last value. For a fixed list without typing use Dropdown.

options.description: Suggestions, one row each. The list scrolls and opens at the current value.

onChange.description: Called with a picked option or a typed value that `parse` accepted.

parse.description: Turns typed text into a value, or `undefined` when it cannot be read. Without it only option labels are accepted.

format.description: Text shown for a value that is not in `options`. Defaults to the value.

label.description: Visible label.

hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for screen readers only.

toggleLabel.description: Accessible name of the open button. Pass it in the page's language.

RadioGroup.description: A labelled set of Radio options. Use it for two to five visible choices.

label.description: Group label, shown as the legend.

options.type: { value: string; label: ReactNode; description?: string | undefined; disabled?: boolean | undefined; }[]

Stepper.description: Change a small number with plus and minus buttons, such as a quantity.

label.description: Accessible name, such as "Quantity".

labels.type: { increase?: string | undefined; decrease?: string | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Accessible names of the buttons in the page's language.

Slider.description: Pick a value on a range. Use Input when an exact number is required.

label.description: Visible label.

showValue.description: Show the current value next to the label.

FileDropzone.description: Drag-and-drop area over a real file input. List chosen files with FileItem.

onFiles.description: Called with the chosen or dropped files.

title.description: Main line, such as "Drop a file here or click to browse".

description.description: Accepted types and the size limit, in words.

FileItem.description: One uploaded file with its progress, result and a remove action.

meta.description: One line of meta: size or what went wrong.

removeLabel.description: Accessible name of the remove button.

TagInput.description: Enter several values as removable tags. Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last one.

label.description: Visible label.

Calendar.description: Month grid for picking one day. Use DatePicker for the field-plus-calendar pattern.

onChange.description: Called with the picked ISO day.

defaultMonth.description: First month to show, as ISO. Defaults to the selected day or today.

min.description: Earliest day that can be picked, as ISO.

max.description: Latest day that can be picked, as ISO.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names.

DatePicker.description: A date field you can type into, with a button that opens a Calendar. Accepts 12.11.2026, 12.11. and ISO. Use it for dates near today; use Input for known dates such as birthdays.

label.description: Visible label.

calendarLabel.description: Accessible name of the calendar button. Pass it in the page's language.

max.description: Latest day that can be picked, as ISO.

min.description: Earliest day that can be picked, as ISO.

onChange.description: Called with the picked ISO day.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for month and weekday names.

SearchField.description: Search box with a suggestion list (combobox). Type to see matches, arrow keys to move, Enter to open one, Escape to close. Width is size/field-lg.
SearchField.example: <SearchField label="Search contacts" value={q} onChange={setQ} results={results} onSelect={open} />

label.description: Accessible name. Hidden visually, like a header search.

onChange.description: Called with the new text. Filter `results` from it.

results.description: Suggestions for the current text, already filtered.

onSelect.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen with click or Enter.

emptyText.description: Shown in the list when the text matches nothing.

labels.type: { clear?: string | undefined; count?: ((n: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Names of the built-in parts. Pass them in the page's language. `count` announces the number of suggestions.

Input.description: Single-line text entry. `type="password"` adds a built-in show or hide button, so never build one yourself. For choosing from a list use Dropdown.
Input.example: <Input label="Email" type="email" value={v} onChange={(e) => setV(e.target.value)} error={err} />

label.description: Visible label. Required unless you pass `aria-label`.

hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for screen readers but hides it visually. Use sparingly, such as a search in a toolbar.

error.description: Error message. Sets the error state and `aria-invalid`. Say what is wrong and how to fix it.

variant.description: `outline` white field with a border (default). `filled` tinted field for a header search (Figma Input Style=Filled).

iconLeft.description: Icon inside the field on the left.

onClear.description: Shows a clear button while there is text. Called when it is pressed.

labels.type: { clear?: string | undefined; showPassword?: string | undefined; hidePassword?: string | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Accessible names of the built-in buttons. Pass them in the page's language.

Textarea.description: Multi-line text entry for comments and descriptions. Use Input for single-line values.

label.description: Visible label.

error.description: Error message. Sets the error state.

maxLength.description: Shows a character counter against this limit.

Checkbox.description: Pick several options that need saving. For one choice of several use Radio. For a setting that applies at once use Toggle.

label.description: Visible label. Pass `aria-label` instead only inside a table row.

indeterminate.description: Shows a dash for a partly selected group.

Radio.description: One option of a set where exactly one is chosen. Group them in RadioGroup.

label.description: Visible label.

Toggle.description: A switch for a setting that takes effect immediately. If the change needs saving, use Checkbox.

onChange.description: Called with the new state. Apply the setting straight away; a Toggle never waits for a Save button.

label.description: Visible label. Required unless you pass `aria-label`.

textSide.description: Which side the label sits on.

Loader.description: Indeterminate loading indicator. Use Skeleton when the layout is known and ProgressBar when the duration is known.

label.description: Announced to screen readers. Pass an empty string only when the parent already announces loading, such as a busy Button.

Skeleton.description: Placeholder while content loads. Match the layout that will appear. Hidden from screen readers; announce loading with `aria-busy` on the region.

type.description: `text` lines, a `row` with a thumbnail, or a `card` block.

ProgressBar.description: Progress when the duration or amount is known.

label.description: Accessible name, and the visible label when `showLabel` is on.

showLabel.description: Show the label above the bar.

Alert.description: A message that stays on the page until resolved. `error` and `warning` announce themselves. Use Toast for a passing confirmation.
Alert.example: <Alert status="error" title="Could not save">Check your connection and try again.</Alert>

status.description: Meaning. Always paired with its icon, so colour is not the only signal.

dismissLabel.description: Accessible name of the close button.

Badge.description: Shows a status, count or category. It is not interactive; use Chip for something people click.

icon.description: Icon before the text. Pair status with text or an icon, never colour alone.

ToastProvider.description: Wrap the app or screen once. Then call `useToast()` anywhere inside. It renders the announcing region for you.

dismissLabel.description: Accessible name of each close button.

Modal.description: A focused task above the page, with a free content area such as a short form. For a yes-or-no confirmation use ConfirmDialog.

open.description: Controls visibility. Render it always and flip this. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener on close.

onClose.description: Called on Escape, the close button or a backdrop press.

footer.description: Footer actions, rightmost is the main one.

footerStart.description: Secondary footer action on the left, away from the main actions, such as Import.

size.description: Width: `small` 400, `medium` 560, `large` 720, `xlarge` 960 for landscape forms in two or three columns.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the close button.

ConfirmDialog.description: The Pop-Up in Figma: a short confirmation before a consequential action. Use it for every delete or anything that cannot be undone. Focus starts on the safe choice.
ConfirmDialog.example: <ConfirmDialog open={open} tone="danger" title="Delete this file?" confirmLabel="Delete file" onCancel={close} onConfirm={remove}>This cannot be undone.</ConfirmDialog>

onCancel.description: Called when the person backs out: Cancel, Escape or the backdrop.

title.description: The question, naming the thing: "Delete this account?".

children.description: The consequence in plain words. Say what cannot be undone.

confirmLabel.description: Confirm label naming the action: "Delete account", never "OK" or "Yes".

tone.description: `danger` for anything irreversible: red confirm, and focus starts on Cancel. `default` for a normal confirmation.

busy.description: Shows progress on the confirm button while the action runs.

Drawer.description: Side panel for details or edits while keeping the page in view.

onClose.description: Called on Escape, close or backdrop.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the close button.

Tooltip.description: Short hint on hover or focus. It never holds the only copy of important text. For richer content use Popover.

children.description: Exactly one focusable element, such as an IconButton.

Popover.description: Small panel attached to a control, with richer content than a Tooltip. Escape and an outside press close it.

trigger.description: Element that opens it, usually a Button.

open.description: Controlled open state. Omit to let it manage itself.

Menu.description: Runs a command from a list, such as a row's actions. Arrow keys and Escape work. To choose a value use Dropdown.

trigger.description: Element that opens it, usually an IconButton.

label.description: Accessible name of the list.

TopNav.description: Links between views within a section, with a navy underline on the current one. This is also what other libraries call Tabs.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

SideNav.description: Left navigation between app sections, 240 wide or a 72 rail when collapsed. A collapsed rail can be `expandable`; with `overflow` it never runs out of room.

items.description: Items in order of priority: the first ones stay visible longest.

label.description: Accessible name.

collapsed.description: Icon-only rail, 72 wide. Each icon shows its name in a tooltip.

theme.description: Surface. `light` is white (default). `dark` is the navy rail from Figma's Side Nav Theme=Dark.

logo.description: Shows the bottle mark in a tile with a divider above the items (Figma Side Nav Logo). The row is as tall as the small Header.

logoLabel.description: Product name next to the mark while the nav is expanded.

sticky.description: Stays in view at full window height while the page scrolls. The nav itself never scrolls.

expandable.description:
With `collapsed`: a toggle at the bottom (and the `[` key) slides the nav out over the page to show names and counts.
A modal-style layer dims and blurs the page; choosing an item, clicking the layer or Escape folds it back. The page does not move.

overflow.description:
Adds a More (⋯) button as the last item. Items that do not fit the height move into its menu from the end of the
list, and come back when there is room. The selected item always stays visible. Use with `sticky`.

moreItems.description: Items that always sit in the More menu, after any that moved there.

labels.type: { expand?: string | undefined; collapse?: string | undefined; more?: string | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Names of the built-in parts. Pass them in the page's language.

footer.description: Footer slot, such as a help card.

Breadcrumbs.description: Shows where a page sits and links back up the trail.

items.description: Trail from the root to the current page. The last item is the current page.

label.description: Accessible name.

Pagination.description: Moves through a long list page by page. It collapses long ranges with an ellipsis. Place it below the Table, never inside.

labels.type: { nav?: string | undefined; previous?: string | undefined; next?: string | undefined; page?: string | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Accessible names in the page's language.

Steps.description: Shows progress through a multi-step process and marks the current step with `aria-current`. It shows progress only; the Back and Next buttons are yours.

current.description: Index of the current step, starting at 0. Earlier steps show as complete.

errorStep.description: Index of a step that has an error.

label.description: Accessible name.

Header.description: App header bar. Renders a `header` landmark.

children.description: Middle slot, usually TopNav or a search Input.

layout.description: `fill`: the middle slot takes the free space (TopNav). `between`: the middle slot keeps its own width (size/field-lg) and sits between the ends, as for a search.

PageHeader.description: Page title, subtitle and primary action. Use one per page, at the top of the content.
PageHeader.example: <PageHeader title="Requests" subtitle="All open requests" actions={<Button>Create request</Button>} />

actions.description: Primary action Button slot, on the right.

size.description: `large` Heading H1 for top-level pages (default). `medium` Heading H4 for record pages, such as one organisation.

icon.description: Icon in a tile before the title, such as `building` for an organisation. With `meta`, the tile sits beside the title and the meta row.

meta.description: Row under the title for short record facts, such as a LabelPicker and a location. Wrap each fact in its own span; they sit on one line, spaced apart.

Footer.description: Page footer with legal text and links.

FilterTabs.description:
Filter tabs (pill tabs): one choice from many filters for the list below, such as a history feed.
Use SegmentedControl for 2 to 4 equal options, Chip for several filters at once, TopNav for views.
FilterTabs.example: <FilterTabs label="Filter history" value={f} onChange={setF} items={[{ id: 'all', label: 'All' }, { id: 'notes', label: 'Notes', count: 5 }]} />

items.description: Filters in order. The first is usually "All".

label.description: Accessible name of the group, such as "Filter history".

variant.description: `pill` soft pill on the selected tab (default). `chip` each tab looks like a Chip. Both stay on one line and scroll sideways when narrow.

UserMenu.description: Profile trigger for the Header. Wrap it in Menu to add the account commands.

subtitle.description: Second line, such as a company.

src.description: Picture URL. Initials show without one.

compact.description: Avatar and chevron only. Name stays available to screen readers.

size.description: `medium` 32 avatar (default) or `large` 48 avatar (Figma User Menu Size=Large).

Avatar.description: A person as picture or initials.

name.description: Person's name. Gives the initials and the accessible name.

status.description: Status dot. Pair it with text if the status matters.

tone.description: Initials on `light` accent tint (default, Figma Type=Letter Light) or `solid` accent (Figma Type=Letter).

AvatarGroup.description: Several people in a small space. Show at most 4.

people.description: People to show; the first `max` are drawn and the rest collapse into a count.

ListItem.figma: List/List Item Leading, List Item Trailing
ListItem.example: <List><ListItem title="Email" description="Weekly" trailing={<Toggle aria-label="Email" checked={on} onChange={setOn} />} /></List>

leading.description: Left slot: Icon, Avatar or ProductThumbnail.

trailing.description: Right slot: text, Badge, Toggle, Button.

List.description: Rows of related items, such as settings, devices or files. For sortable columns of data use Table.
List.figma: List/List Item Leading, List Item Trailing

ProductThumbnail.description: Product image tile for tables and lists.

src.description: Product photo URL. Without one an icon placeholder shows.

EmptyState.description: Shown when there is nothing to display. Say why and offer the next action.
EmptyState.example: <EmptyState title="No devices yet" description="Link a device to sign in faster." action={<Button>Link device</Button>} />

title.description: Why it is empty, as a heading.

size.description: `medium` for a page or section, `small` inside a card.

Timeline.description: Chronological list of events, such as request history or an activity log.

children.description: TimelineItem or ActivityItem children, newest first.

label.description: Accessible name.

progress.description:
Scroll-linked: the line fills as the page scrolls, markers that passed the reading line light up and the entry at
the reading line is highlighted. Best with ActivityItem. Off when people prefer reduced motion.

ActivityItem.description:
A rich event in a Timeline, such as an email, call or note, shown as a card next to an icon marker.
Rhythm: subject and meta form one heading block, the preview sits apart, the footer apart again. The marker lines up with the subject.
Figma: Activity Item.
ActivityItem.example: <ActivityItem icon="mail" title="Subject" meta={['28 Oct, 10:24', <>Anna → <PeopleList people={to} max={1} /></>]} lines={2} footer={<FileChipList files={files} onDownload={save} />} onOpen={open}>Preview</ActivityItem>

icon.description: Marker icon on the timeline rail, such as `mail` for an email or `phone` for a call. The card itself repeats no type icon.

title.description: Subject line, the strongest text of the card.

meta.description: Quiet line right under the subject: date, sender and recipients. Pass a list to split the facts with a thin line (InlineList).

children.description: Preview text. One line by default; see `lines` and `expanded`.

footer.description: Bottom row, such as attachments (FileChipList) or related people. Several children are split by a divider.

actions.description: Right of the subject: small buttons such as a Reply SplitButton and a more IconButton. The row keeps the height of a small button.

lines.description: Clamps the preview to this many lines with an ellipsis. The detail view shows the rest.

onOpen.description: Makes the card clickable (hover, press and focus states). The subject becomes the button; links, buttons and popovers inside keep their own action.

AccordionItem.description: One expandable row of an Accordion.

Accordion.description: Stacked expandable sections, when people need only some of the content.

Card.description: The one surface for grouped content: white, radius/xl, soft shadow. The Figma Card/* layouts are all this with different content. Do not stack cards inside cards.

headerAction.description: Top-right slot, such as a Menu or Badge.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of `title`. Use 3 inside a Modal or under another h2. Defaults to 2.

collapsible.description: Adds a chevron that shows and hides the content. Needs a `title`.

defaultOpen.description: With `collapsible`: starts open. Defaults to true.

toggleLabel.description: With `collapsible`: accessible name of the chevron, such as "Show or hide Details". Defaults to the title.

KeyValueList.description: Label and value pairs, such as the details of a record. Figma: Key Value Pair.

items.description: Rows in order. Values can be text or a link.

layout.description: `stacked`: label then value, wrapping (default). `columns`: labels in their own column, values beside them.

Table.description: Table only: toolbars, filters and Pagination sit around it. Rows tint on hover. Header checkbox selects all. Selected rows get the accent tint.

caption.description: Required table name for screen readers; hidden visually.

selected.description: Selected row keys. Turning it on adds a checkbox column.

empty.description: Rendered in place of the rows when there are none, usually EmptyState.

labels.type: { selectAll?: string | undefined; selectRow?: ((row: T) => string) | undefined; } | undefined

BarChart.description: Compare values across categories. Colours come from chart/1 to chart/6.

label.description: Accessible summary of what the chart shows.
Accessible summary.

DonutChart.description: Parts of a whole, 2 to 6 segments.

label.description: Accessible summary.

Gauge.description: One score against a full range, drawn as a half circle.

label.description: Label and accessible name.

ProgressList.description: Labelled progress bars in a list.

BreakdownBar.description: One stacked bar plus rows of name, count and share. Use it for compact breakdowns in a side panel.

label.description: Accessible name of the whole breakdown, such as "Top-Aktivitäten".

items.description: Parts of the whole, largest first. Values are counts; the share is worked out.

Stat.description: One KPI: label, value and change.

label.description: What is measured.

trend.description: Direction of the change. It is shown with an arrow, not colour alone.

DataCard.description: Card for any chart, with an optional row of Stat.

GlobalSearch.description:
App-wide search: a header field that opens a large panel over a dimmed page, with categories on the left and
hits on the right. Matches are highlighted. Arrow keys move through hits, Enter opens one, Escape closes.
For a simple field with a short suggestion list use SearchField.
GlobalSearch.figma: Input (Style=Filled) + search panel (not in Figma yet)
GlobalSearch.example: <GlobalSearch label="Search" value={q} onChange={setQ} categories={cats} category={cat} onCategoryChange={setCat} results={hits} onSelect={open} heading="All results" />

label.description: Accessible name of the search field.

categories.description: Categories in the left column. The first is usually "All".

onCategoryChange.description: Called when a category is chosen.

results.description: Hits for the current text and category, already filtered.

onSelect.description: Called when a hit is opened with click or Enter. The panel closes.

heading.description: Heading above the hits, such as "All results".

emptyText.description: Shown when the text matches nothing.

footer.description: Bottom of the category column, such as a help link.

labels.type: { clear?: string | undefined; categories?: string | undefined; count?: ((n: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Names of the built-in parts. Pass them in the page's language.

LabelPicker.description:
Shows a label as a Badge and lets people change it in place, such as in a table cell. A pencil appears on hover and focus.
The popover has a search, the labels as badges (the current one checked) and an add button for a new label.
Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes. It is positioned against the window, so table scrolling never cuts it off.
LabelPicker.example: <LabelPicker label="Label for Anna" value={id} options={labels} onChange={setId} onCreate={add} />

value.description: Selected label id, or null for none.

onChange.description: Called with the chosen label id.

onCreate.description: Called with the typed name when someone adds a new label. Add it to `options` and select it. Leave out to hide the add button.

label.description: Accessible name of the trigger, such as "Label for Anna Roell". The current label is added after it.

labels.type: { search?: string | undefined; add?: string | undefined; addNamed?: ((name: string) => string) | undefined; empty?: string | undefined; none?: string | undefined; } | undefined
labels.description: Names of the built-in parts. Pass them in the page's language.

size.description: Badge size of the current label: `tiny` in tables and lists (default), `small` in a PageHeader meta row.

InlineEdit.description:
A value that people change in place, such as a table cell or a detail field. A pencil appears on hover and focus.
Text: Enter or leaving the field saves, Escape cancels. Date: picking a day saves, Escape cancels.

value.description: Current value. For `type="date"` an ISO day `YYYY-MM-DD`.

onChange.description: Called with the new value when people save. Not called when the value did not change.

label.description: Accessible name of the edit button, such as "Edit name of Anna Roell".

type.description: Kind of value. `date` opens a Calendar.

display.description: What to show while not editing, such as a link or formatted date. Without it the value shows as text and a click on it edits.

locale.description: For `type="date"`: BCP 47 locale for the Calendar.

SplitButton.description:
Main action plus a menu of related actions, split by a divider (Hydra "Button Select").
Use it when one action is the usual choice and a few others belong to it, such as "Kontakt" with "Import".
SplitButton.example: <SplitButton icon="plus" onClick={add} menuLabel="More ways to add" items={[{ label: 'Import', icon: 'upload', onSelect: openImport }]}>Contact</SplitButton>

children.description: Label of the main action, verb first: "Kontakt", "Create request".

items.description: Related actions behind the arrow. The first one should repeat or extend the main action.

menuLabel.description: Accessible name of the arrow button and its menu, such as "More ways to add".

variant.description: Emphasis, same as Button. Hydra Button Select has Primary and Secondary.

icon.description: Icon before the label, such as `plus` for create actions.

FieldAction.description:
Inline action that belongs to the field above it, such as adding another phone number.
Not a button style: no padding or background, icon on the field's left edge, underline on hover.
Place it directly under the field in a `Stack gap="2"` (8, same as label to input). For standalone actions use Button.

children.description: What it adds or does, verb last in German UIs: "Telefonnummer hinzufügen".

CloseButton.description: Closes a dialog, drawer, toast or alert. Regular icon weight, rounded-square hover, focus ring only when focused.

label.description: Accessible name in the page's language, such as "Schließen".

size.description: `medium` for dialogs and drawers (32 area, 20 icon), `small` for toasts and alerts (24 area, 16 icon).

Editor.description:
Text editor for notes and messages: a field that opens into a formatting toolbar with Cancel and Save.
Closed it is one line; focus opens it. Toolbar buttons wrap the selection in Markdown. Bold, italic and underline are toggles:
they show as selected (aria-pressed) while the cursor is inside that mark, and pressing them again removes it. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter saves, Escape cancels.
Use Textarea for a plain form field without formatting.
Editor.example: <Editor label="Notiz" placeholder="Notiz schreiben … Mit @ jemanden erwähnen" value={v} onChange={setV} onSave={save} labels={{ cancel: 'Abbrechen', save: 'Speichern' }} />

label.description: Accessible name of the text field, such as "Note".

value.description: Current text. Formatting is written as Markdown (`**bold**`, `_italic_`, `- item`).

onSave.description: Called with the text when someone saves. Clear `value` afterwards.

onCancel.description: Called after Cancel clears the text and closes the editor.

placeholder.description:
Hint in the empty field, such as "Write a note … Mention someone with
@ ".

defaultExpanded.description: Starts open with the toolbar showing. By default it opens on focus and closes when empty and left.

labels.description: Names of the built-in parts. Pass them in the page's language.

DateNav.description: A date between two bare chevrons that step back and forward. The chevrons have no box; their colour changes on hover.
DateNav.example: <DateNav label="Mittwoch, 11. November 2026" onPrevious={prev} onNext={next} previousLabel="Vorheriger Tag" nextLabel="Nächster Tag" />

label.description: The date or range shown, such as "Mittwoch, 11. November 2026".

previousLabel.description: Accessible names of the arrows, in the page's language.

ActivityCard.description:
The next activity as one click target with an accent stroke, such as in a Fokus panel.
The title is the button and stretches over the card, so links in `rows` keep working on top.
ActivityCard.example: <ActivityCard title="Jahresgespräch vorbereiten" type="Termin" rows={[{ icon: 'calendar', content: 'Mi, 11. Nov. 2026 · 09:00–09:30' }]} onOpen={open} />

title.description: Activity title. The whole card opens it.

type.description: Type under the title, such as "Termin".

rows.description: Short facts with an icon each, such as date and participants. Links inside stay their own targets.

AvailabilityTimeline.description:
Shared availability, as in a scheduling assistant: one row per person on one time axis, plus an "all participants" row.
Free time for everyone is a green fill, the planned time in conflict a red fill, the chosen slot a green frame.
Fills sit behind calendar entries and grid lines, so nothing under them is hidden. Entries show no titles.
AvailabilityTimeline.example: <AvailabilityTimeline title="Mittwoch, 11. November 2026" columns={[{ id: '2026-11-11', label: 'Mi 11.' }]} rows={rows} free={free} selection={{ column: '2026-11-11', start: 660, end: 690, valid: true }} onPick={pick} onPrevious={prev} onNext={next} />

columns.description: One column is a day view; several (such as Mon to Fri) a week view.

free.description: Time when every row is free. Drawn as a light green fill across all rows.

selection.description: The chosen slot. `valid: false` (someone is busy) draws it red; otherwise a deep green frame with a check.

planned.description: The originally planned time after the selection moved away from it, drawn as a red fill.

onPick.description: Called with the column and the start of the clicked step.

title.description: Header: the date or week, with arrows.

view.type: { value: string; options: SegmentOption[]; onChange: (v: string) => void; label: string; } | undefined
view.description: Optional view switch on the right, such as Tag and Woche.

hours.description: Visible hours in minutes. Defaults to 08:00 to 18:00.

workHours.description: Working hours in minutes; outside them is hatched. Defaults to 08:30 to 17:30.

step.description: Click snapping in minutes. Defaults to 30.

labels.description: Names of the built-in parts, in the page's language.

legend.description: Fixed legend entries, in order. Defaults to all five. Leave out what explains itself, such as `selected` while planning.

StatusSummary.description: A quiet bar that states what is set and whether it works, such as the time of a Termin above its availability. Read-only.
StatusSummary.example: <StatusSummary icon="calendar" title="Mi, 11. Nov. 2026 · 11:00–11:30" description="Alle Teilnehmer sind frei." />

title.description: Main line, such as the date and time.

description.description: Second line, such as who is busy.

tone.description: `default` accent tile, `error` red tile and red description.

trailing.description: Right slot, such as a Badge.

PeopleList.description:
Names of people inline, such as recipients or participants: "Anna Berg, Ben Kohl +3". Names are blue links to the person's record;
your own name stays plain. "+N" opens a list of exactly the hidden people on hover, click or Enter. Inherits the surrounding text style.
PeopleList.example: <PeopleList people={[{ name: 'Anna Berg', href: '#/kontakte/1' }, { name: 'Ben Kohl', href: '#/kontakte/2' }]} max={1} moreLabel={(n) => `${n} weitere Personen`} />

people.description: People in order. The first `max` show inline; the rest sit behind "+N".

moreLabel.description: Heading of the "+N" list, such as `(n) => \`${n} weitere Personen\``. Pass it in the page's language.

FileChip.description: An attached file as a compact pill: name and its own download button. Size and type live in the detail view. Use FileItem for uploads.

name.description: File name, shown in full on hover when it is cut.

downloadLabel.description: Accessible name of the download button. Pass it in the page's language. Default: "Download <name>".

FileChipList.description: Attachments on one wrapping line, such as in an ActivityItem footer.

downloadLabel.description: Accessible name of each download button. Pass it in the page's language.

label.description: Accessible name of the list, such as "Anhänge".

InlineList.description: Short facts on one line, split by a thin vertical line: "4. Nov. 2026, 14:20 | Johannes Finzer → Anna Berg | 12 Min.". Inherits the surrounding text style.

items.description: Facts in order, such as a date, a person and a duration. Empty items are skipped.
